CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_api_key_deleted_at" ON "api_key" ("deleted_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_api_key_token_unique" ON "api_key" ("token") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_api_key_revoked_at" ON "api_key" ("revoked_at") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_api_key_redacted" ON "api_key" ("redacted") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "IDX_api_key_type" ON "api_key" ("type") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
